scene: The pod opens outside, unlocking three dazzling transit routes across the city.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view of an elevated transit platform under evening skies. On the far left, a purple escalator ascends skyward. To the left, the player in her red bomber jacket and roller skates stands by the open spherical pod. In the centre, a yellow noodle monorail waits. On the far right hangs a bamboo cable car.
shown: a bright ascending escalator glowing with purple neon on the far left
a steaming yellow noodle-cart monorail idling on tracks at the centre
a woven bamboo cable car swinging gently from wires on the far right
